name: San Sebastián (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Divided diagonally by a white wavy band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red above for the patron Saint Sebastian the Martyr and the events of 1868, green below.
history: San Sebastián is a town and municipality in northwestern Puerto Rico, formerly Pepino, where the Grito de Lares rebels were defeated on 24 September 1868; the red stands for the patron Saint Sebastian the Martyr and for the blood shed that day.
